name: reclip
description: Download videos from almost any website. Lightweight, self-hosted media downloader with a clean web UI.
one_liner: A self-hosted app with a clean web page where you paste a video link from almost any site and download it as a video or audio file — no ads, no third-party service.
buyer: A journalist, researcher, or content archivist who needs to reliably save source video/audio before it disappears, and doesn't trust free ad-laden download sites with their links.
business_use_cases: A journalist archives source social-media clips for a story before they can be deleted or taken down.
A podcast producer pulls audio from guest appearances on other shows for personal reference clips (with rights permission).
A social-media manager downloads a brand's own posted content across platforms to keep a local backup library.

money_ideas.idea: Offer it as a managed, hosted instance for teams that don't want to self-host, billed monthly.

steal_this: Be upfront that downloading other people's video/audio content without a license can violate platform terms and copyright law — the honest weekend build is a hosted version for archiving your own or explicitly licensed content, not a general bypass tool.
